shell_commands: git diff --name-only HEAD~1 2>/dev/null || git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo "No git history"

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(tools): validate input against inputSchema in ToolRegistry.execute

- Import Ajv as default export (not named export)
- Add input validation before executor runs, returning ToolResponse on error
- Format validation errors to mention field paths and constraints without leaking values
- Fix early-return pattern and member-chain depth in acceptance test

Fixes: #37
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | head -20
